guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate based on three criteria: Reasoning (use of required reasoning categories), Faithful (hallucination-free), and Coverage (use of all highlighted cells).

Annotators answer three questions: 1) Reasoning: Does the generated summary use all reasoning categories required? 2) Faithful: Is the generated summary hallucination free? 3) Coverage: Are all highlighted cells used?
We ask the annotators to provide a label between -yes (score 1), partially (score 0.5), or no (score 0).
